claim_updates.reason: Frozen decision rule triggers REJECTED (C5 cache heterogeneity FAIL diff=0.2506>2*SE, C7 negative control FAIL |r|=0.1204<0.15), but audit finds the REJECTION is contaminated by two measurement defects: (1) V3 selection bias — valid cache-enabled non-304 composition is skewed (profile n=2, data_list n=2, session_status n=40 valid vs 40/40/40 expired), inflating pooled cache-enabled r to -0.453 vs stratified per-endpoint r ~0.04; (2) V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE — expired tokens decode without permission_level, defaulting to 'read' etag, violating spec clause 8 signal independence. The audit ceiling bounds C-FRESHNESS to EXPERIMENTAL on localhost stochastic Flask mock (r=0.002-0.046, n=480, 4 independent experiments all audit PASS). Within-endpoint non-304 orthogonality appears strong (stratified pooled r ~0.04) but is not validated under frozen protocol due to selection bias. No confirmatory or falsifying evidence accumulated from this experiment for the broader C-FRESHNESS claim. Status unchanged pending fixes and re-run.

product_action: No product action. C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to localhost mock. Parallel-channel architecture NOT justified for production-like infrastructure. No promotion authorized.
next_question: After fixing V3 selection bias (endpoint-stratified or balanced non-304 sampling), V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE (derive permission_level from session independent of token expiry), and re-running C5/C7 with n>=800, does the frozen decision rule yield CONFIRMED (all C1-C7 pass) or REJECTED (any fails) at delta=0.15 on the production-like testbed?
reason: REVISE because the frozen REJECTED outcome (C5 FAIL, C7 FAIL) is contaminated by two audit-identified measurement defects: (1) V3 selection bias — valid cache-enabled non-304 samples are 91% session_status (40/44), inflating pooled cache-enabled r from stratified ~0.04 to -0.453, causing C5 diff to appear 0.466 instead of ~0.04; (2) V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE — expired tokens lack permission_level payload, causing write-permission expired requests to use read-etag (c6b1...) instead of write-etag (c471...), violating spec clause 8 (no shared variables between signal domains). C7 negative control failure (|r|=0.1204<0.15) may reflect weak V1 entropy bifurcation under header-only extraction or endpoint heterogeneity (profile -0.406, data_list -0.317, session -0.032). The audit recomputes correct non-304 per-endpoint r as 0.009/0.122/-0.013 (near-zero within-endpoint orthogonality), suggesting the frozen REJECTED is not a clean scientific falsification but a measurement-design artifact. The frozen decision rule is implementable correctly once V3 selection bias and ETag leakage are fixed. B-FLASK-ONLY baseline (r=0.0263, TOST PASS) continues to confirm orthogonality without infrastructure, providing strong prior that the localhost result is genuine. Product deployment decision deferred pending clean measurement.
